about: Three live test deals on Sepolia, one per ending, shown under the demo's player (T-427). Taken from docs/tasks/T-420-outsider-scenarios.md, 'One live deal per scenario', and each deal's public record on the live API (offeredAt and endedAt are the record's commitment.offered and settlement event times; tx is the settlement event's transaction). A refresh is a change of this file and one publish.

endings.title: The work passes
endings.rule: The seller is paid, and the buyer gets the key to the work in the same step.
endings.measure: from the seller's offer to the payment
endings.how: The agreed checks ran first. The first reviewer asked for a second look, and a panel of 5 AI judges from 2 model makers passed the work, 5 of 5.

endings.title: The work fails
endings.rule: The price goes back to the buyer, and the work stays locked.
endings.measure: from the seller's offer to the refund
endings.how: The same terms as the deal that passed; only the delivered text differed. A panel of 3 AI judges rejected it, 3 of 3, and the reviewer kept its fee of 1 test dollar.

endings.title: The seller goes silent
endings.rule: Nothing arrived by the deadline, so the whole payment went back to the buyer, without the buyer asking.
endings.measure: from the seller's offer to the refund

amount.label: back to the buyer: the price and the reviewer's fee

endings.how: The seller took the deal and never delivered. The terms gave it 5 minutes from the offer; the payment went back 65 seconds after that deadline.
